name: github_create_issue
title: Create a GitHub issue
description:
Open a new issue in a GitHub repository as the signed-in user, through their connected GitHub account (needs the repo scope). Writes to GitHub; not idempotent.
Returns: number, url, title, state and created_by (GitHub login).
Inputs (* required): owner* (user or organization; letters, digits, -, _ and .); repo* (repository name, same characters); title* (1-256 characters); body (Markdown, up to 65,536 characters); labels (up to 20 label names).
To read issues use connected_http_request with /repos/OWNER/REPO/issues. Runs only for a signed-in SAJHA user; when the account is not linked, or lacks the scope, the call returns a request to connect it with a link instead of a result.
Example: {"owner": "octocat", "repo": "hello-world", "title": "Broken link in README", "body": "The install link returns 404.", "labels": ["docs"]}

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Writes to GitHub as the caller; marked destructive so Ask SAJHA and MCP clients confirm first.
